notes: 2.0 - absolute encoder model. Position now comes from PCNT hardware quadrature counting plus a slowly corrected offset from MCPWM capture of the absolute pulse, instead of quadrature interrupts corrected by a twice-a-second pulseIn. Opt-in via the enc_model setting; legacy remains the default and the automatic fallback if capture or PCNT fail to start. Also in this build: RFI storm guard, wrong-way guard, fail-closed absolute staleness, hardware-timer step generation for steppers, and the stall-detection minimum-speed fix.
